name: travel-exam-planner
description: Plan door-to-door travel for exams and concursos, optimizing cost-benefit or total cost and producing an itemized budget workbook.

interface.shortDescription: Plan efficient, low-risk trips for exams
interface.longDescription: Build and compare door-to-door itineraries for in-person exams and concursos. The plugin combines calendar constraints, official exam facts, flights, buses, lodging, local transport, safety buffers, and itemized total cost; optimizes for best value or lowest total cost; and returns a workbook with purchase and reservation links when available.
defaultPrompt: Planeje minha viagem para uma prova com o menor tempo fora de casa.
Compare voo, ônibus e hospedagem para meu próximo concurso.
Revise meu roteiro de prova e identifique riscos e custos ocultos.
